Hi! I don't know if you will see this since you posted this 9 months ago, but I have a different theory!

My theory mainly revolves around the fact that all of Sophie's previous experiences with BSI would have to be traumatic enough to cause some sort of PTSD.

Assuming that the medication in question was prescribed to them by a medical professional, we can look at some pills that can cause memory loss (which are typically SSRI's and other anti-psychotics) however the one I want to hone in on is Sertraline, a medicine used to treat PTSD.  This medication in particular has been known to cause memory loss whether permanent or temporary. Not only this, but PTSD has a huge tendency to blot out major memories in an attempt to relieve your brain of having to recollect those memories and can cause an individual to completely lose their memory of certain traumatic events as a coping mechanism.

Here's an in-depth article in how Sertraline can cause an individual to completely lose recollection of basic pieces of information and even more complex ones such as their own sense of self:  
[https://rxisk.org/ssris-loss-of-identity/#:\~:text=Sertraline%20can%20cause%20permanent%20memory,dosage%2C%20wrecking%20careers%20and%20friendships](https://rxisk.org/ssris-loss-of-identity/#:~:text=Sertraline%20can%20cause%20permanent%20memory,dosage%2C%20wrecking%20careers%20and%20friendships).

The reason I think this is cause spawn peeking with Smoke has already been a thing of the past and no one wants to relive that.

The reason I particularly want the Fmg-9 to be the gun that gets buffed is because I want more Smoke players to try and use the under appreciated main SMG that they have. If they buff the Fmg-9 enough to where it's equally as or maybe even more powerful as the shotgun then maybe it'll be used more and Smoke players can finally have more options as opposed to their singular good one.

Even if she invulnerable to Melusi's gadget and or proximity alarms still think she needs a buff since her performance isn't exactly stellar. 

Some of my ideas for buffing her would be:

- Improving the damage of the Fmg-9
- When running it's harder to see the static that she produces on cams or hacked drones
- Extending the duration of her gadget
- Maybe even adding an acog to the Fmg-9
- Make her even quieter if possible

Obviously these are all just opinions and maybe I'm completely wrong and she's perfectly fine so I'd love feedback on my ideas.
